- scripts/guard_differential.py:673-677 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Redundant corpus comparisons leading to duplicate entries in ShapeResult.
  WHY: The script iterates over all hook trees (HOOK_TREES) and for each tree, it runs comparisons for the union of all corpora. If the same guard exists in both trees or if a corpus is applied to multiple trees redundantly, the same shape comparison is performed and reported multiple times, inflating regression counts and producing redundant CI annotations.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/guard_differential.py, Location: run_check missing_corpus loop, ~line 670
  PROBLEM: When both hook trees contain a changed `*_guard.py` with no corpus, the same path is reported once per tree, overstating `missing_corpus` and producing duplicate CI error lines.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: Deduplicate by hook stem before appending and report each missing corpus once with both tree paths joined into the `::error::` message (or just the live tree). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- scripts/guard_differential.py, Location: materialize at ref is None, ~line 514
  PROBLEM: `for item in source.iterdir(): if item.is_file():` silently drops subdirectories of `.claude/hooks/` or `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/`.
  WHY: A guard importing a sibling module in a subdirectory would not have that module copied by `materialize`; suggested minimal fix is to log a one-line `GUARD_DIFFERENTIAL notice tree=<…> skipped_subdir=<path>`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
